3791.title: Native cookie recovery investigation
3791.rootCauseOneLine: Cookie deletion does not invalidate scheduler state; foreground renewal leaves a still-unexpired session without cookies. Original Safari truncation cause remains unverified.
3791.proposedFix: Await cookie clearing and renew the session before reload; verify native recovery separately.
3791.caveats: Scheduler-boundary reproduction only; no Safari or native UI reproduction. Authentication changes are outside the automatic simple-fix scope.
